text_en: At that time, says the Lord , I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.
text_cn: 在那时候──上主的断语──我将作以色列各宗族的天主，他们将作我的人民。

text_en: Thus says the Lord : The people who survived the sword found grace in the wilderness; when Israel sought for rest,
text_cn: 上主这样说：逃脱了刀剑的人民，在旷野中找到了宠遇；以色列来到了自己安身的地方。

text_en: the Lord appeared to him from far away. I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore I have continued my faithfulness to you.
text_cn: 上主自远处显现给她说：我爱你，我永远爱你，因此我给你保留了我的仁慈；

text_en: Again I will build you, and you shall be built, O virgin Israel! Again you shall take your tambourines, and go forth in the dance of the merrymakers.
text_cn: 我要再修建你，而你必再建立起来；你必再带上你的小鼓，出来欢乐歌舞；

text_en: Again you shall plant vineyards on the mountains of Samaria; the planters shall plant, and shall enjoy the fruit.
text_cn: 再在撒玛黎雅山上栽种葡萄，栽种培植，必有收获；

text_en: For there shall be a day when sentinels will call in the hill country of Ephraim: “Come, let us go up to Zion, to the Lord our God. ”
text_cn: 因为终有一天，守望的人要在厄弗辣因山上喊说：起来，让我们上熙雍去，到上主我们的天主那里去！

text_en: For thus says the Lord : Sing aloud with gladness for Jacob, and raise shouts for the chief of the nations; proclaim, give praise, and say, “Save, O Lord , your people, the remnant of Israel. ”
text_cn: 因为上主这样说：你们应为雅各伯欢呼，向为首的民族喝采，传扬称赞说：上主救了自己的百姓，以色列的遗民。

text_en: See, I am going to bring them from the land of the north, and gather them from the farthest parts of the earth, among them the blind and the lame, those with child and those in labor, together; a great company, they shall return here.
text_cn: 看，我由北地引他们归来，从大地的尽头召集他们，其中有瞎子，有跛(bǒ)子，有怀孕的和正在生产的，形成一大队回到这里来。

text_en: With weeping they shall come, and with consolations I will lead them back, I will let them walk by brooks of water, in a straight path in which they shall not stumble; for I have become a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.
text_cn: 他们含泪前行，我却抚慰引导，领他们踏上不会跌倒的坦途，来到溪流旁，因为我是以色列的慈父，厄弗辣因是我的长子。

text_en: Hear the word of the Lord , O nations, and declare it in the coastlands far away; say, “He who scattered Israel will gather him, and will keep him as a shepherd a flock. ”
text_cn: 万民！请听上主的话，向遥远的海岛宣传说：那昔日驱散以色列的，再要聚集他们，看守他们像牧童看守自己的羊群。

text_en: For the Lord has ransomed Jacob, and has redeemed him from hands too strong for him.
text_cn: 因为上主必拯救雅各伯，从比他更强者的手中将他赎回。

text_en: They shall come and sing aloud on the height of Zion, and they shall be radiant over the goodness of the Lord , over the grain, the wine, and the oil, and over the young of the flock and the herd; their life shall become like a watered garden, and they shall never languish again.
text_cn: 他们将要前来，在熙雍山巅欢呼，涌向上主的美物，饱享谷、麦、酒、油、小牛小羊；他们的心灵要好像受灌溉的田园，再也不感憔悴。

text_en: Then shall the young women rejoice in the dance, and the young men and the old shall be merry. I will turn their mourning into joy, I will comfort them, and give them gladness for sorrow.
text_cn: 那时，处女必欢欣鼓舞，老幼必相聚同乐，因为我将使他们的悲哀变成喜乐，使他们由自己的忧苦中获得安慰欢乐；

text_en: I will give the priests their fill of fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my bounty, says the Lord .
text_cn: 我将以肥脂滋润司祭的心灵，以美物饱饫（yù）我的人民──上主的断语。

text_en: Thus says the Lord : A voice is heard in Ramah, lamentation and bitter weeping. Rachel is weeping for her children; she refuses to be comforted for her children, because they are no more.
text_cn: 上主这样说：“听！在辣玛有叹息声，酸辛哭泣：辣黑耳悲悼自己的儿子，不愿受安慰，因为他们已不存在了！”

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Keep your voice from weeping, and your eyes from tears; for there is a reward for your work, says the Lord : they shall come back from the land of the enemy;
text_cn: 上主这样说：“要止住痛哭，不再流泪，因为你的辛苦终必有报──上主的断语──他们必会由敌地归来！

text_en: there is hope for your future, says the Lord : your children shall come back to their own country.
text_cn: 你的前途大有希望──上主的断语──你的子孙都要归回自己的疆域。

text_en: Indeed I heard Ephraim pleading: “You disciplined me, and I took the discipline; I was like a calf untrained. Bring me back, let me come back, for you are the Lord my God.
text_cn: 我实在听到了厄弗辣因在悲叹说：你惩罚了我，我受了杖击，有如一头不驯服的公牛犊；你使我归来，我必归来，因为你是上主，我的天主。

text_en: For after I had turned away I repented; and after I was discovered, I struck my thigh; I was ashamed, and I was dismayed because I bore the disgrace of my youth. ”
text_cn: 的确，我自离弃你以后，我已后悔；在我觉悟以后，我拍腿自惭自愧，因为我又染上了我少年时的耻辱。

text_en: Is Ephraim my dear son? Is he the child I delight in? As often as I speak against him, I still remember him. Therefore I am deeply moved for him; I will surely have mercy on him, says the Lord .
text_cn: 厄弗辣因岂不是我的宠儿，我钟爱的娇子？因为我几时恐吓他，反倒更顾念他；对他我五内感动，不得不大施爱怜──上主的断语。”

text_en: Set up road markers for yourself, make yourself signposts; consider well the highway, the road by which you went. Return, O virgin Israel, return to these your cities.
text_cn: 请你给自己树立路程碑，设置指路牌，细心回想你走的路线，以往你走过的大道；以色列处女！归来，回到你自己的城邑。

text_en: How long will you waver, O faithless daughter? For the Lord has created a new thing on the earth: a woman encompasses a man.
text_cn: 你要流浪到几时？叛逆的女儿！因为上主在地上正在创造一件新事：女人包围男人。

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Once more they shall use these words in the land of Judah and in its towns when I restore their fortunes: “The Lord bless you, O abode of righteousness, O holy hill! ”
text_cn: 万军的上主，以色列的天主这样说：“当我转变他们的命运时，在犹大地和她城市中的人，还要用这话祝贺说：正义的所在，神圣的山岭！愿上主祝福你。

text_en: And Judah and all its towns shall live there together, and the farmers and those who wander with their flocks.
text_cn: 犹大和她各城中的人，农夫和随羊迁徙的人，将要同住在那里，

text_en: I will satisfy the weary, and all who are faint I will replenish.
text_cn: 因为我要振作困乏的心灵，饱饫一切苦闷的心灵。──

text_en: Thereupon I awoke and looked, and my sleep was pleasant to me.
text_cn: 至此，我醒来了，我看见了，我的睡眠为我实在甘甜。──

text_en: The days are surely coming, says the Lord , when I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of humans and the seed of animals.
text_cn: 看时日将到──上主的断语──我要给以色列家和犹大家播散人种和兽种；

text_en: And just as I have watched over them to pluck up and break down, to overthrow, destroy, and bring evil, so I will watch over them to build and to plant, says the Lord .
text_cn: 就如昔日我曾监视他们，为将他们拔除、破坏、推翻、毁灭、损害；同样，日后我必要监视他们，为将他们建设、栽培──上主的断语──

text_en: In those days they shall no longer say: “The parents have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge. ”
text_cn: 在那时日里，人必不再说：“祖先吃了酸葡萄，子孙的牙齿也要酸软。”

text_en: But all shall die for their own sins; the teeth of everyone who eats sour grapes shall be set on edge.
text_cn: 不，各人只因自己的罪恶而死；只有吃酸葡萄的人，自己的牙齿才酸软。

text_en: The days are surely coming, says the Lord , when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and the house of Judah.
text_cn: “看，时日将到──上主的断语──我必要与以色列家和犹大家订立新约，

text_en: It will not be like the covenant that I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt—a covenant that they broke, though I was their husband, says the Lord .
text_cn: 不像我昔日──握住他们的手，引他们出离埃及时──与他们的祖先订立的盟约；虽然我是他们的夫君，他们已自行破坏了我这盟约──上主的断语──

text_en: But this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, says the Lord : I will put my law within them, and I will write it on their hearts; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
text_cn: 我愿在那些时日后，与以色列家订立的盟约──上主的断语──就是：我要将我的法律放在他们的肺腑里，写在他们的心头上；我要作他们的天主，他们要作我的人民。

text_en: No longer shall they teach one another, or say to each other, “Know the Lord , ” for they shall all know me, from the least of them to the greatest, says the Lord ; for I will forgive their iniquity, and remember their sin no more.
text_cn: 那时，谁也不再教训自己的近人或兄弟说：“你们该认识上主”，因为不论大小，人人都必认识我──上主的断语──因为我要宽恕他们的过犯，不再记忆他们的罪恶。

text_en: Thus says the Lord , who gives the sun for light by day and the fixed order of the moon and the stars for light by night, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— the Lord of hosts is his name:
text_cn: 那指定太阳照耀白日，规定月亮星辰照耀黑夜，拨动海洋使波涛怒号，号称“万军的上主”的上主这样说：

text_en: If this fixed order were ever to cease from my presence, says the Lord , then also the offspring of Israel would cease to be a nation before me forever.
text_cn: 假若这些规定已由我面前消失──上主的断语──以色列种族在我面前也就永不再是一个民族。

text_en: Thus says the Lord : If the heavens above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth below can be explored, then I will reject all the offspring of Israel because of all they have done, says the Lord .
text_cn: 上主这样说：假若人能测量在上的诸天，能探察在下大地的基础，我也就因他们所做的一切，抛弃整个以色列种族──上主的断语。”

text_en: The days are surely coming, says the Lord , when the city shall be rebuilt for the Lord from the tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.
text_cn: “看，时日将到──上主的断语──上主的城必要重建，不但自哈纳乃耳堡直到角门，

text_en: And the measuring line shall go out farther, straight to the hill Gareb, and shall then turn to Goah.
text_cn: 而且测量的绳墨还要向外伸展，直到加勒布丘，再转向哥阿；

text_en: The whole valley of the dead bodies and the ashes, and all the fields as far as the Wadi Kidron, to the corner of the Horse Gate toward the east, shall be sacred to the Lord . It shall never again be uprooted or overthrown.
text_cn: 连满了尸首和灰烬的整个山谷，以及直到克德龙溪流和东边马门角旁所有的田地，都将祝圣给上主，永不再遭受摧残破坏。”
